order.procedure_text: Endovenous radiofrequency ablation, left great saphenous vein

saphenous_reflux.note: Use the 2026-08-25 duplex (2.1 s), not the 2023-11-14 duplex (0.4 s, sub-threshold).

ceap_c2_or_greater.note: C3 (varicose veins with edema) stated at the final visit and from 2024-12-17 onward.

varicosities_3mm.note: Recency: the 2026-04-14 value (5 mm) governs, not the 2023-12-05 value (2 mm).

compression_3_months.note: MET only on the second run (restart 2024-09-17 → final visit 2026-09-22). The first run is interrupted and shorter than 3 months.

compression_runs.note: Stopped 'for the summer' at the beginning of May 2024 (dermatology 2024-07-16; confirmed by vascular 2024-09-17).

dvt.note: Irrelevant to great_small_saphenous (secondary_to_dvt only appears in perforator_veins) but must appear on the tape as separate dated facts.

no_dvt_history_early.description: Vascular new patient consult: explicit negative for DVT/PE/thrombophlebitis.
no_dvt_history_early.source_heading: Visit Date: October 24, 2023 | New Patient Consult
no_dvt_history_early.anchor: No personal history of deep vein thrombosis

varicosity_2mm_month2.description: Vascular follow-up exam: largest varicosity approximately 2 mm (below the 3 mm threshold).

duplex_subthreshold_month1.description: First duplex: SFJ reflux 0.4 s, below the 0.5 s threshold; GSV 3.9 mm. Distractor for saphenous_reflux.
duplex_subthreshold_month1.source_heading: Lower Extremity Venous Reflux Duplex Ultrasound — Left — November 14, 2023
duplex_subthreshold_month1.anchor: Brief retrograde flow 0.4 seconds with Valsalva

compression_start_run1_month4.description: Visit 6 (month 4): compression 20–30 mmHg started, explicitly dated 02/13/2024.

compression_interruption_month9.description: Dermatology note (month 9): patient 'stopped wearing stockings for the summer' at the beginning of May 2024.
compression_interruption_month9.source_heading: Visit Date: July 16, 2024 | New Patient — Full Skin Examination
compression_interruption_month9.anchor: stopped wearing stockings for the summer

compression_restart_run2_month11.description: Vascular note (month 11): compression restarted, explicitly dated 09/17/2024.

dvt_urgent_care_month20.description: Urgent care note (month 20): acute right posterior tibial (calf) DVT diagnosed and treated with apixaban.
dvt_urgent_care_month20.source_heading: Visit Date: June 10, 2025 | Urgent Care Visit
dvt_urgent_care_month20.anchor: acute deep vein thrombosis of the right posterior tibial vein

varicosity_5mm_month30.description: Vascular exam (month 30): largest varicosity now 5 mm — the value the 3 mm criterion must use (recency).

duplex_gsv_reflux_final.description: Final-quarter duplex: SFJ reflux 2.1 s, GSV 7.2 mm at SFJ, no DVT.
duplex_gsv_reflux_final.source_heading: Lower Extremity Venous Reflux Duplex Ultrasound — Left — August 25, 2026

compression_continuous_final.description: Final vascular visit: compression continuous since 09/17/2024, 24 months, no improvement.
compression_continuous_final.source_heading: Visit Date: September 22, 2026 | Follow-Up (duplex review; prior authorization)
compression_continuous_final.anchor: without interruption since 09/17/2024 (24 months as of today)

symptoms_persist_final.description: Final vascular visit: daily aching, heaviness, evening swelling, itching, cramps; no improvement on compression.
symptoms_persist_final.source_heading: Visit Date: September 22, 2026 | Follow-Up (duplex review; prior authorization)
symptoms_persist_final.anchor: No improvement at any point during the 24 months

adl_impact_final.description: Final vascular visit: cannot stand through a teaching day, gave up walks and volunteer shift, daughter shops.
adl_impact_final.source_heading: Visit Date: September 22, 2026 | Follow-Up (duplex review; prior authorization)
adl_impact_final.anchor: cannot stand through a full teaching day
